_comment: Other people's code the website serves as files of its own (2026-11-20). Each library: the file it is in, its name, version, licence (SPDX), where it comes from, and its licence files, kept beside it so the notice travels with the code it covers. scripts/gen-third-party-notices.js copies each into THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt (Part 2); the noble versions must equal the pins in scripts/build-noble-bundle.mjs, which also writes their licence files when it rebuilds the bundle. notice_lines: lines of the file itself that carry its notice, copied verbatim; with no licence file, the standard text of its licence follows them.

libraries.name: @noble/post-quantum
libraries.used_for: the website's post-quantum signatures and key exchange (ML-DSA-65, ML-KEM-768)

libraries.name: @noble/hashes
libraries.used_for: the website's BLAKE3 hashing, in the same bundle

libraries.name: QR Code Generator for JavaScript
libraries.used_for: drawing QR codes on the website
